full_judgment:
A.K.M. Fazlur Rahman, J: This Rule issued at the instance of the complainant petitioner on an application under section 561A of the Code of Criminal Procedure directed against the judgment and order dated 20.11.2001 passed by the learned Sessions Judge, Pirojpur in Criminal Revision No. 62 of 2001 rejecting the revisional application affirming the order dated 11.2.2001 passed by the Magistrate, 1st class, Pirojpur in M.P. case No. 144 of 2001 under sections 302/201/34 of the Penal Code dismissing the petition of complaint under section 203 of the Code of Criminal Procedure. 

 17. In the result, the Rule is made absolute. The impugned judgment and order dated 20.11.2001 passed by the learned Sessions Judge, Pirojpur in Criminal Revision No. 62 of 2001 is hereby set aside. The learned Magistrate is directed to hold inquiry on the petition of complaint in accordance with the provision of section 202 of the Code of Criminal Procedure. The. Order passed by this court earlier staying further proceeding of Sessions Case No. 12 of 2001 of the Court of Sessions Judge, Pirojpur will remain in force till the disposal of the M.P. Case No. 144 of 2001 of the Court of Magistrate, 1st Class, Pirojpur.
